notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice (API returned missing for the full title and for "Hellblade"). hellblade.fandom.com answers the API, with 17 linked pages, including "Senua", "Hela", "Lorestones", "Bridge to Helheim" and "Sea of Corpses"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. All 14 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions, so every one was placed by name. The chapters follow the Steam schema order, which matches falling unlock rates (82.8% for the first, then 29 to 44%), so they are a rough guess at story order, and the chapter groupings themselves are a judgement call. "Stories From the North" is earned by only 5.4% of players, so it was treated as an optional goal; the data does not say what it is for.
